test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the statement carefully. Identify the option that the statement depends upon for its conclusion to be valid. Select the option that best expresses this underlying assumption.

Statement: A new smartphone app designed to manage personal finances will be successful because it provides users with personalized budget recommendations.

options.text: Users are currently spending too much money on unnecessary purchases.
Other existing financial apps do not offer any personalized budget recommendations.
Users will be willing to follow the budget recommendations provided by the app.
The app can securely store the financial data of a very large user base.

solution:
Given Statement:

A new smartphone app will be successful because it provides users with personalized budget recommendations.

Assumption:

I. Users are currently overspending –

False (Not necessary for the argument).

II. Other apps do not offer personalization –

False (Not required for the conclusion).

III. Users will be willing to follow the budget recommendations –

**True** (Essential for the app’s success).

IV. The app can securely store data –

False (Important, but not the basis of the conclusion).

So, only Assumption III is required.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
